title: Fppf sheafification sections over an algebraically closed field have presheaf representatives
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $K/k$ an algebraically closed field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let $F$ be a presheaf of sets in the site-containing universe on the big fppf site of $k$-schemes [def-pc-fppf-site]. Put $T=\operatorname{Spec}K$. Every $s\in F^\#(T)$ is the image of some $a\in F(T)$ under the canonical sheafification map [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

source.place: Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification), combined with morphisms.tex Tag 01TF (lemma-closed-point-fibre-locally-finite-type); the specialization is already proved by exists_toSheafify_app_eq_of_isAlgClosed in the adopted source library.

proof.text: By local surjectivity of the sheafification unit choose an fppf covering on which s has a representative. Choose a member meeting the unique point of Spec K. The source implementation uses Presheaf.imageSieve_mem and exists_flat_mem_of_mem_fppfTopology_over.

The chosen member is a nonempty scheme locally of finite type over K. It is Jacobson and has a closed point; the residue field at that point is K since K is algebraically closed. Thus the covering morphism has a section τ : Spec K -> Z. The source proof uses nonempty_inter_closedPoints and pointOfClosedPoint.

Pull the local presheaf representative back along τ. Naturality of the sheafification map, τ followed by the covering morphism equal to the identity, and functoriality imply that its image is s. This is exactly the existing complete source proof; no new Lean declaration or proof hole is introduced.

lemma exists_toSheafify_app_eq_of_isAlgClosed {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed K] (P : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1))
    (s : (sheafify (fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) P).obj
      (.op (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))))) :
    ∃ a, (toSheafify (fppfTopology.over (Spec (.of k))) P).app _ a = s
